statement: Let s be a positive integer and let (Hi)i∈J be a finite indexed family of hypergraphs on a common ground set. Suppose every edge is nonempty and has size at most s. If, for every nonempty I ⊆ J, the union S i∈I Hi has a matching of size strictly greater than s(|I| − 1), then there are edges Ei ∈ Hi, one for each i ∈ J, that are pairwise disjoint.
